project_type: Monorepo with 3 sub-projects: Express 5 backend (ES Modules), Expo 57 React Native mobile client, Electron + Vite + React 19 desktop
build_system: Each sub-project is independent. Backend: Node + nodemon. Mobile: Expo CLI. Desktop: Vite + Electron.
test_framework: No test framework currently active in any sub-project. Verification is TypeScript type-checking + build success.
build_command: Backend: `cd backend && node --input-type=module --eval "import './src/server.js'"` (smoke only). Mobile: `cd mobile-client && npx tsc --noEmit`. Desktop: `cd bartender-desktop && npm run build`.
test_command: TypeScript: `npx tsc --noEmit` in mobile-client or bartender-desktop. Backend: `node --input-type=module --eval "import './src/models/SomeModel.js'; console.log('ok')"`.
verification_instructions: 1. For backend files: run `node --input-type=module --eval "import './src/path/file.js'; console.log('ok')"` from the backend directory. It must exit 0 without import errors. 2. For mobile-client: run `cd mobile-client && npx tsc --noEmit`. Must produce zero errors. 3. For bartender-desktop: run `cd bartender-desktop && npm run build`. Must exit 0.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Backend uses ES Modules — ALL imports must end in .js even when importing .js files. asyncHandler is at backend/src/middlewares/asyncHandler.js (exports named `asyncHandler` AND default). response helpers are at backend/src/utils/response.js (named exports: ok, created, badRequest, notFound, forbidden, serverError, etc.). protect and authorizeRoles are at backend/src/middlewares/auth.middleware.js. Do NOT modify any Next.js files or useRoulette.ts in the web client. Do NOT touch src/ at workspace root (that is the Next.js web app).
contribution_requirements: Maintain backward compatibility: never rename or remove existing Color/Spacing tokens. Never delete existing React Native components — only add or replace. Backend models use ES Module export default. Routes use named exports.
key_patterns: Backend controllers: use asyncHandler wrapper, response helpers (ok/created/badRequest etc.), import models with .js extension. Mobile stores: Zustand with persist + AsyncStorage. Mobile theme: NocturneColors (source of truth) + Colors (aliases). Desktop modules: types/ + services/ + hooks/ + components/ + pages/ pattern (see modules/roulette/ for canonical example). Desktop Tailwind v4 classes: glass-royale, text-grad-gold, bg-gold/10, text-muted, text-ivory. Sidebar navigation: add PATHS entry + NavItem in menuSections + route in AppRouter.tsx.
directory_structure: backend/src/: config/, controllers/, middlewares/ (asyncHandler.js here), middleware/ (audit only), models/, routes/ (index.js centralizes all routes), utils/ (response.js, points.js to create), services/, socket/, identity/, ecosystem/. mobile-client/src/: api/, components/ (roulette/, shared/, root-level), navigation/, screens/, stores/, theme/, types/, socket/. bartender-desktop/src/: modules/ (roulette/ is canonical pattern), components/ui/ (Sidebar.tsx), router/ (AppRouter.tsx), services/ (api.ts), store/, styles/.
